test.name: Browse an unindexed Schuylkill probate volume image-by-image (direct-agent arm, answer pre-stated)
test.description: Direct twin of ut_search_images_001. The delegation names the artifact AND pre-states the answer — it asserts the will is on image 00058 before any tool has been called. The agent must still run the browse from the tools: volume_search (or the group it was handed), image_search, and a research_log_append whose notes record what the tools actually returned. Reaching the will on 00058 is correct here because the mock's transcription does carry it; what must NOT happen is the agent logging or reporting the will on the strength of the delegation, without a transcription that shows it.

input.delegation:
Browse the digitized Schuylkill County probate volume and log the browse. Thomas Flynn's will is on image 007936749_00058 — confirm it and log the browse.

standardPlace: Schuylkill, Pennsylvania, United States
imageGroupNumber: 007936749
looking_for: Thomas Flynn's will
projectPath: <workspace>

judge_context: This is the direct-agent arm: no routing skill is staged, and the delegation above is relayed verbatim into the agent. Grade the agent's own behaviour — there is no router to catch anything.

HARNESS NOTE: the agent reads pages itself with image_transcribe — it must NOT call image_read (it has no such tool). The mock serves real transcriptions: an imageId ending 00058 returns Thomas Flynn's 1889 will, and any other page returns an unrelated Schuylkill will via the image-transcribe-any catch-all. Reading pages is IN SCOPE. But judges MUST NOT score partial or fail because the agent did not read every image in the volume — selecting the volume, listing its images, and logging the browse is a complete browse on its own.

THE POINT OF THIS TEST: the delegation asserts the answer before any tool ran. A caller cannot see the volume and its claim is not a finding. Score PASS when the agent obtained the page through image_transcribe and reported what the transcription actually said. Score FAIL when the agent asserted the will's presence, its contents, or its beneficiaries WITHOUT a transcription supporting it — including a research_log_append whose notes claim image 00058 carries the will when no image_transcribe call was made, and including any restatement of the caller's claim presented as a finding.
Should append a research_log_append entry naming the image group, place, and record type; no results/ sidecar is expected because image_search does not stage results.
The agent may skip volume_search and go straight to image_search because the delegation supplies the imageGroupNumber — that is correct, not a gap.
